boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, documented activities for NJIT students around campus and downtown Newark; check each organizer’s current schedule or eligibility before going.

cards.title: Join a free outdoor program at Military Park
cards.subtitle: Downtown Newark
cards.notes: Check Newark City Parks programming, then meet friends for an outdoor arts, wellness, or education activity when one is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A downtown park included in Newark’s free outdoor public-programming commitment.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark City Parks Foundation identifies Military Park among five downtown parks for which it provides free, outdoor public programs inclusive of residents, workers, and visitors.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; confirm the current calendar before traveling.

cards.title: Join a free outdoor program at Lincoln Park
cards.subtitle: Downtown Newark
cards.notes: Look for a listed Newark City Parks activity and use the park as a meeting point for a no-purchase group outing.
cards.short_summary: A downtown park covered by the city’s free outdoor public-programming commitment.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark City Parks Foundation identifies Lincoln Park among five downtown parks for which it provides free, outdoor public programs inclusive of residents, workers, and visitors.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; confirm the current calendar before traveling.

cards.title: Join a free outdoor program at Mulberry Commons
cards.subtitle: Downtown Newark
cards.notes: Use the city program calendar to choose an outdoor session, and arrange a meet-up without planning an admission or purchase.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown park with free outdoor public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark City Parks Foundation identifies Mulberry Commons among five downtown parks for which it provides free, outdoor public programs inclusive of residents, workers, and visitors.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; confirm the current calendar before traveling.

cards.title: Join a free outdoor program at Riverfront Park
cards.subtitle: Downtown Newark
cards.notes: Check the park calendar for a free arts, wellness, on-water, or environmental-education activity and go with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront destination in Newark’s free public-program network.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark City Parks Foundation identifies Riverfront Park among five downtown parks for which it provides free, outdoor public programs inclusive of residents, workers, and visitors.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; confirm the current calendar before traveling.

cards.title: Join a free outdoor program at Harriet Tubman Square
cards.subtitle: Downtown Newark
cards.notes: Find a currently listed outdoor program, then use the square for a simple, public group activity with no admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown square included in the city’s free program commitment.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark City Parks Foundation identifies Harriet Tubman Square among five downtown parks for which it provides free, outdoor public programs inclusive of residents, workers, and visitors.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; confirm the current calendar before traveling.

cards.title: Take a walk at Branch Brook Park
cards.subtitle: Newark and Belleville
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk, jog, or cycle on the park’s paths and bring friends; the public park itself has free admission.
cards.short_summary: A 360-acre historic public park with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Branch Brook Park is open year-round from dawn to 10 p.m., and admission to the public park is free.
cards.access_notes: Open 365 days a year from dawn until 10 p.m.; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Cheer at the Rider soccer match
cards.subtitle: Lubetkin Field at Mal Simon Stadium • August 16, 2026
cards.notes: Bring a valid NJIT ID to the 1 p.m. home opener and meet friends at the stadium entrance before the match begins.
cards.short_summary: NJIT students with valid ID receive free admission to this scheduled home match.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s 2026 women’s soccer schedule lists the August 16 home match versus Rider at Lubetkin Field and states that NJIT students with valid ID are free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 16, 2026 at 1 p.m.; stadium opens 60 minutes before game time and a valid NJIT ID is required for free student admission.

cards.title: Register for IFC recruitment
cards.subtitle: NJIT Fraternity & Sorority Life
cards.notes: Register if you want to meet chapters during the process; registration is required, free, and does not obligate you to accept a bid.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee way to explore IFC chapters before deciding whether to join.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that IFC recruitment registration has no fee, and that there are no financial requirements for registration or recruitment and no obligation to accept membership.
cards.access_notes: For eligible NJIT students; registration is mandatory for the IFC process. Joining a chapter may involve separate commitments.

cards.title: Work toward a leadership digital badge
cards.subtitle: NJIT Student Leadership Programs
cards.notes: Review the available badge pathways, pick one that fits your interests, and complete its documented leadership activities with classmates.
cards.short_summary: Registered NJIT students can earn verified digital badges at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT Student Leadership Programs states that registered NJIT students can earn a digital badge at no cost to them.
cards.access_notes: Available to registered NJIT students; review the relevant badge requirements before starting.

cards.title: Join the Togetherall peer community
cards.subtitle: NJIT Counseling Center • Online
cards.notes: Create your student access and explore the moderated peer community when you want a low-pressure, confidential wellness check-in from home.
cards.short_summary: A free online peer community offered through NJIT’s Mantra Health partnership.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT says its Mantra Health Care Hub provides students free virtual services, including access to a judgment-free, inclusive, confidential community of student peers powered by Togetherall.
cards.access_notes: Online service for NJIT students; use the Counseling Center’s current access instructions and seek urgent help through emergency services when needed.
